name: The Other Way
invitation: Three blocks stand across the clearing. The opening shot meets the middle one and stops. A way past them is still unused, and taking one leaves the others.
physicalQuestion: Why fire again after a finished stop, when nothing was scored and the stop itself was not a mistake?

challenge.label: Send one line past the blocks

nearbySensitivity: At the opening, yaw 0, elevation 16, charge 0.55, one slider step still meets the middle block and stops short of it: yaw plus or minus 0.5 degrees, elevation plus or minus 0.5 degrees, charge plus or minus 0.01, and origin plus or minus 0.5 m. The left example at yaw -10.5, and the right example at yaw 10.5, stay clear of every block at those same one-step changes. The straight carry at elevation 24 stays a carry at those same one-step changes. These are neighbours of tested shots, not a search for a lip.
validationEvidence: 1153 headless Havok shots, seed 20261109, via docs/experiments/foundry/lanes/wildcard/sweep.mjs and scripts/range/run.mjs. Zero setups were rejected. The four tested shots are replayed by scripts/foundry/validate.mjs. Neighbour steps were fired and are not replayed. Not run: a physical phone, and no claim is made that anyone enjoys the lines.

limitations.concept: Several finished lines, and none of them is the miss.
limitations.missing: A goal can name one circle, one contact, or a phrase. Naming any one landing would mark the other finished lines as misses, so this world has no goal.
limitations.extension: An optional goal that accepts any of two or three existing first-ground circles, with no new collider and no score. Not built.

limitations.concept: The choice should read as the blocks and the open air, not as a music exercise.
limitations.missing: Nothing on the ground marks a side, and Survey has no caption for the gaps. The invitation is the first sentence of the play card. A saved copy drops that sentence, because it is not stored on the world file.
limitations.extension: Two non-colliding ground marks. Not built.

limitations.concept: A dull face tall enough that a straight shot could not carry it.
limitations.missing: Blocks are 4 m tall and have no height control, so a higher or harder straight shot carries the middle. That carry stays as one of the ways.
limitations.extension: One height offset on the existing block, keeping its friction and restitution. Not built.
